journeys.name: Workbench empty state
journeys.goal: A first-time solo developer can understand what CodeNext is and find the next action without internal-enterprise hints.

journeys.name: Gateway settings
journeys.goal: The AI gateway setup feels local-first, understandable, and safe for personal open-source use.

journeys.name: Docs overview
journeys.goal: The docs clearly introduce CodeNext as a cloud AI coding platform for an outside user.
expect: 云端 AI 编程平台

journeys.name: Docs quickstart
journeys.goal: A new open-source user can find a practical first-run path.

journeys.name: Direct import route
journeys.goal: Opening import directly should be a graceful, closed-loop experience instead of an implementation error.

journeys.name: Skill Hub
journeys.goal: The skill workflow reads as personal/local-first and avoids internal marketplace dependencies.

journeys.name: MCP extensions
journeys.goal: MCP extension management has an understandable empty/setup state for a solo user.

journeys.name: API docs
journeys.goal: API documentation is reachable and does not expose internal service assumptions.

journeys.name: Gateway logs
journeys.goal: Gateway logs are understandable as a personal debugging feature and do not fail when empty.

healthChecks.name: Gateway model list
healthChecks.suggestion: Keep model discovery working after saving a personal gateway, because this is the first proof that AI coding can actually run.

healthChecks.name: Personal-edition update check
healthChecks.suggestion: When updater is disabled, return a clear skipped state instead of a server error.
